commands:
python3 << 'EOF'
import json
import subprocess

# Get issues from local server
local_result = subprocess.run(
    ["sonarless-mcp", "results", "--format", "json"],
    cwd="<world>/project",
    capture_output=True,
    text=True
)

if local_result.returncode == 0 and local_result.stdout:
    print("Local Results:")
    print(local_result.stdout)
else:
    print(f"Local error: {local_result.stderr}")
EOF
